synthesis_focus: Analyze whether Brigitte and Hubert Buchner have valid claims for non-pecuniary and/or pecuniary damages against Dr. Kindermann and/or the hospital under Austrian law, focusing on breach of contract/duty of care, informed consent, and the special doctrine of 'Wrongful Birth' (unerwünschte Schwangerschaft/Mehrlingsschwangerschaft).
